profile.summary:
Hi, I’m Alberto, a full-stack developer with more than two decades of professional experience building scalable web apps.
My tech stack: React, JavaScript / TypeScript, Next.js, Remix, Node.js, OpenAI, REST APIs, CSS (BEM, SASS, Styled Components), and strong focus on web accessibility (WCAG). I have an eye for design and UX, in fact I've worked as a designer for some companies.

I also build features and products leveraging AI-assisted development, spec driven development, staying up to date with the evolving AI ecosystem and continuously improving my workflow.

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Author's design packages developer, making custom solutions for brands like Cambridge University Press Oxford University Press, Pearsons, Cornelsen, Westermann, Cengage/National Geographic, Richmond, etc.
Knowing how our products work and how to add value to your customers.

Some tasks:
- Implementing WCAG AA Accessibility for Author products
- Working collaboratively with product owners and customers to provide the best solution.
- Holistic overview of the product and legacy and help the team understand better. Working closely with the designers,  back-end engineers, and Product Owners in a collaborative development environment.
- Code reviews and provide clear concise feedback.
- Junior engineers mentorship.
- Help the team write clean code that anyone can still understand a while after.
- Travelling to customers’ headquarters regularly to attend meets or PI meetings. Daily video meets with the team and customers.
- Doing my best to create clean, easy-to-understand, and efficient code.
- Team lead for some projects.

The tools:
- JavaScript ES5/ES6… ECMAScript 2020, jQuery (for legacy), CSS3, LESS/SASS, and HTML5.
- React.
- Responsive web design, accessibility standards (WCAG), and frontend performance optimisation
- Git, Node, bash, command line.
- Assembla, Jira.
- Agile.
